entries.source: Review and integrate PR 463. For the existing profile, install the updated desktop and migrate once before using the CLI. Preserve a consistent pre-migration profile backup; older binaries do not read the new identity format. The unrelated IURIO HOME/.env failure remains.
entries.text: PR 463 prüfen und integrieren. Für das bestehende Profil den aktualisierten Desktop installieren und einmal migrieren, bevor die CLI verwendet wird. Ein konsistentes Profil-Backup vor der Migration erhalten; ältere Programme lesen das neue Identitätsformat nicht. Der unabhängige IURIO-Fehler zu HOME/.env bleibt bestehen.

problem.statement: The standalone CLI cannot read the desktop encryption key.

scope: Extend PR 463 in its clean existing worktree. Migrate only Pod execution identities, not provider secrets, owner login or relay registration.

approval.reference: Chat approval of the filesystem/sandbox approach: "Ja das passt. Setz das um, dann tun wir uns viel leichter." The attached direction records the approved concept; this execution breakdown was written afterward.

completion.summary: Implementation and local acceptance are complete. Native fixtures pass 34 cases, with one optional external-parser case skipped. Existing owner profile migration and signed deployment were not performed.
